title: MCP++ A2A TerminalEvidence@1
description: Terminal A2A Task evidence under the activated MCP++ execution extension. Public TaskState remains completed/failed/canceled/rejected; this object carries MCP++ evidence CIDs (receipt_cid, event_cid, proofs) without inventing a parallel lifecycle. Interface: A2AExtensionSchema@1. Normative prose: a2a-extension.md §6.11, §8.
$comment: Schema marker: mcp++/a2a/terminal-evidence@1. Cross-trust portable success REQUIRES receipt_cid; missing receipt on claimed portable success is non-conformant even when TaskState is completed.

extension_uri.description: Activated extension URI that produced this terminal evidence.

task_id.description: A2A Task.id for the terminal task.

task_state.description: Terminal A2A TaskState. MUST be one of completed, failed, canceled, rejected.

portable.description: When true, claims cross-trust portable MCP++ success/failure evidence. Portable completed REQUIRES receipt_cid.

envelope_cid.description: Request envelope CID. MUST be present when an envelope was used.

receipt_cid.description: ExecutionReceipt@1 CID. Required when portable=true and task_state=completed.

event_cid.description: Event DAG node CID linking envelope/result/receipt.

proof_cids.description: Authority / verification proof CIDs checked or emitted.

error.description: Optional structured error when task_state is failed/canceled/rejected.
